# Salvia

> Salvia turns a post-encounter voice note into a policy-checked, audit-locked clinical record before anyone signs off. AI + audio + clinical documentation + compliance, built for every clinical specialty. Not a scribe — a compliance suite.

Salvia is a clinical governance automation platform. Clinicians dictate a post-encounter voice note; Salvia transcribes, extracts structured fields into the right statutory form, runs it against the clinic's linked policy framework, and locks the record with an audit trail. Every note checks itself. Every record defends itself.

Salvia is domain-agnostic. The first beachhead market is veterinary clinics in New Zealand, with parallel pilots in UK dental and aged care.

## Product pillars

- [Point-of-Care Evidence](https://hellosalvia.com/products/point-of-care-evidence): Audio capture → transcription → structured field extraction → typed clinical record.
- [Statutory Form Infrastructure](https://hellosalvia.com/products/statutory-form-infrastructure): Jurisdiction- and vertical-specific forms with typed widgets (consent, drug register, incident, pain scale) — never free text where structure is required.
- [Institutional Compliance Hub](https://hellosalvia.com/products/institutional-compliance-hub): Policy framework linked to forms; every submission is policy-checked pre sign-off, with full audit trail and PDF export themed per clinic.

## Verticals

- [Veterinary](https://hellosalvia.com/veterinary): RCVS (UK), VCNZ (NZ), AVBC (AU) records standards. Lead beachhead market.
- [Dental](https://hellosalvia.com/dental): CQC (UK), AHPRA (AU) records inspections.
- [Aged care](https://hellosalvia.com/aged-care): Incident reporting, medication administration, restraint authorisation.
- [General practice](https://hellosalvia.com/general-practice): Cross-vertical clinical documentation.
